parametrized_description: An office supply company makes two types of printers: color and black-and-white. The color team can produce at most MaxColorPrinters per day and the black-and-white team at most MaxBWPrinters per day. Both use a shared machine with capacity MaxMachineCapacity per day. Color printers yield ProfitColorPrinter profit and black-and-white printers yield ProfitBWPrinter profit. Determine how many of each to produce to maximize profit.

MaxColorPrinters.description: Maximum number of color printers produced per day

MaxBWPrinters.description: Maximum number of black and white printers produced per day

MaxMachineCapacity.description: Maximum capacity of the shared paper tray installing machine per day

ProfitBWPrinter.description: Profit per black and white printer

ColorPrinters.description: Number of color printers to produce per day

BWPrinters.description: Number of black and white printers to produce per day

constraints.description: Number of color printers must not exceed MaxColorPrinters.
Number of black and white printers must not exceed MaxBWPrinters.
Total printers must not exceed the shared machine capacity.
Number of color printers must be non-negative.
Number of black and white printers must be non-negative.

objective.description: Maximize profit from selling color and black-and-white printers.
